lines.lyric_translation: Even a fool knows this
You’re the best thing I’ve got

lines.lyric: Dashi neol hyanghae One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 널 향해 One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_translation: Once again towards you One more step, I will never stop
I shouldn’t turn away / It’s too late

lines.lyric_hangul: 너에게 돌아가는 길의 막차가 끊겼다 yeah
lines.lyric_translation: The last train to return to you has stopped

lines.lyric: Jogeum deo seodureul geol i huhwedo imi neujeotta
lines.lyric_hangul: 조금 더 서두를 걸 이 후회도 이미 늦었다
lines.lyric_translation: I should’ve hurried It’s too late to regret it now

lines.lyric: Haneureun ajik parande wae nae modeun ge heuryeojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 하늘은 아직 파란데 왜 내 모든 게 흐려져
lines.lyric_translation: The sky is still blue but why is everything blurry

lines.lyric: Heurithan shiya sok neoman seonmyeonghage geuryeojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 흐릿한 시야 속 너만 선명하게 그려져
lines.lyric_translation: Within my blurred vision I can only see you clearly

lines.lyric: Geuttae naega i monnan jajonshim jom beorilgeol
lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 내가 이 못난 자존심 좀 버릴걸
lines.lyric_translation: I should’ve let go of my foolish pride then
I’m only regretting now for missing out on the chance
For whatever reason
I really hate myself for not getting close to you
I should’ve come up with any reason
To stop this situation / (I should’ve held on to you)
Don’t go Don’t leave me
Please turn around and look at me Please don’t go
If you go further away
I might fall apart by myself
Even a fool knows this
You’re the best thing I’ve got

lines.lyric: Dashi neol hyanghae One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 널 향해 One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_translation: Once again towards you One more step, I will never stop
I shouldn’t turn away
I know it because I’m a fool
I can’t live without you

lines.lyric: Dashi neol hyanghae One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 널 향해 One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_translation: Once again towards you One more step, I will never stop
I’ll always be on track
I was walking following your pace
Then I got lost for a moment

lines.lyric: Eoryeobge nega namgin baljagugeul ttara georeodo
lines.lyric_hangul: 어렵게 네가 남긴 발자국을 따라 걸어도
lines.lyric_translation: Even though I barely follow your remaining footsteps
My mind is storming at every crossroad
Is it just me who misses us so much?
I wonder how far you’ve gone away?

lines.lyric: Uri hamkke hal sungan geu isang soge
lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 함께 할 순간 그 이상 속에
lines.lyric_translation: The ideal moment that we’ll be together
I got too used to it that it became my daily life
For whatever reason
I really hate you because I feel so far from you
I should’ve come up with any reason
To stop this situation / (I should’ve held on to you)
Don’t go Don’t leave me
Please turn around and look at me Please don’t go
There are no irreversible mistakes

lines.lyric: Deo isang uimi eopneun harureul meomchwo
lines.lyric_hangul: 더 이상 의미 없는 하루를 멈춰
lines.lyric_translation: Stop the meaningless days
Even a fool knows this
You’re the best thing I’ve got

lines.lyric: Dashi neol hyanghae One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 널 향해 One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_translation: Once again towards you One more step, I will never stop
I shouldn’t turn away
I know it because I’m a fool
I can’t live without you

lines.lyric: Dashi neol hyanghae One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 널 향해 One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_translation: Once again towards you One more step, I will never stop
I’ll always be on track
Even after time keeps passing by
This constant desperation of mine

lines.lyric: Chatge haneun geoya maeil bammada nareul chajawa
lines.lyric_hangul: 찾게 하는 거야 매일 밤마다 나를 찾아와
lines.lyric_translation: Makes me look for you You come to me every night
And tantalize me again
You tantalize me more
You also hurt me
I don’t know (I don’t know)
I don’t know (I don’t know)
I can never let you go
I can never let you go

lines.lyric: Naega eotteoke neol noeul su itgennyago?
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 어떻게 널 놓을 수 있겠냐고
lines.lyric_translation: How could I ever let you go?

lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 없는 하루를 걷기엔 발걸음이 너무도 무겁다
lines.lyric_translation: My steps feel too heavy / To make it through the day without you

lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 널 향해 One more step, I will never stop
lines.lyric_translation: Once again towards you One more step, I will never stop
I’ll always …
I know it because I’m a fool
I can’t live without you
